clause: StudioPattern tiled + live-source + pattern editing mode + swatch storage [STU-VEC-017,STU-VEC-067,STU-VEC-051 pattern]

scope.summary: Implement StudioPattern tiled fills (tile-layout grid/brick-by-row/brick-by-column/hex-by-row/hex-by-column, brick/hex offset, tile size with move-with-art, spacing, overlap order, side/corner/start/end tiling for path application), transformable independently of the filled object, plus a live-source pattern tiling another in-document object; a pattern editing mode isolates the tile artwork with live preview + dimmed neighbors and exits without materializing tiles; patterns store as typed swatches (edit-updates-all-references, break-link).
acceptance_criteria: tiled + live-source patterns + isolation edit mode + swatch storage; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: pattern panel + pattern-edit mode reachable via author_id
test: tile layouts + independent fill transform; live-source pattern tiles another object; edit mode updates all references without materializing tiles

risk_if_missed: No patterns; tiled fills + pattern editing missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
